title: What Are AEO and GEO? How to Show Up in ChatGPT Answers
description: What is AEO and GEO? How to show up in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, the 7 things to do first, and how to check if AI tools mention you.
h1_em: and Does My Business Need Them?
dek: How to get your small business mentioned in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and voice answers, and what to do first.

faq.q: Is SEO dead because of AI?
faq.a: No. AEO and GEO build on the same foundations as SEO: useful content, a fast and technically sound site, and trust. Good SEO makes AEO and GEO much easier.

faq.q: Can I pay to appear in ChatGPT answers?
faq.a: Not in the normal answers. Being mentioned comes from having clear, trustworthy information about your business across the web.
A plain-text file at the root of your website that summarises your business and links to your most important pages, written for AI tools to read. It's a newer, emerging convention, quick to add.

related_blurb: Nunik Co. builds websites with schema markup, FAQ content, open AI crawler access and an llms.txt file from the start, so search engines and AI tools can read and recommend your business.
